$description: The format menu. To make a piece, name the format here and the correct canvas, lockup, and margins are selected deterministically. This is what fixes the wrong-asset bug: selection, not regeneration. Colour and type never change per format.

brand.name: Northlight
brand.$note: FICTIONAL SAMPLE BRAND. Replace with yours. See kit/NEW-BRAND.md.

card-16x9.label: Title card / presentation ground
card-16x9.notes: The one format with a full-bleed texture. Add your own approved reference and measure this template against it.

social-1x1.label: Square social post
social-1x1.notes: Paper ground with a texture panel. The everyday piece.

sting.label: Motion sting / animated logo
sting.notes: Built by compositing the real texture into the real logo's own alpha on canvas. Nothing is redrawn. Deterministic in t, so it exports frame-accurately.

banner-3x1.label: Wide banner
banner-3x1.notes: PENDING. No reference, no template. If asked for one, say no approved reference exists and ask for one. Do not improvise a layout: an improvised layout becomes the de facto standard the moment it ships once.

colour_usage.$description: Which logo variant goes on which ground. Deterministic, so nobody has to guess.

pending_assets: Your approved reference designs, one per format, into reference/. Without them the templates cannot be measured against anything.
Any additional lockup (horizontal, stacked) your brand actually uses.
